name: Locally Orderless Image (LOI)
definition: A method for differentiable rendering optimization that replaces standard pixel-wise image comparison with matching of local histograms (distributions of intensity values) to extend gradient support for sparse gradients caused by motion in image space.
summary: Locally Orderless Image is a differentiable rendering technique that replaces pixel-wise comparison with local histogram matching to preserve high-frequency details and enable reliable convergence in inverse rendering.
